Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing day spas to offer or supply without charge wine or beer by the individual glass to a customer for consumption on the premises.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to allowing day spas to offer or supply withoutcharge wine or beer by the individual glass to a customer forconsumption on the premises; and adding a new section to chapter 66.20RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) There shall be a permit known as a day spa permit to allow theholder to offer or supply without charge wine or beer by the individualglass to a customer for consumption on the premises. The customer mustbe at least twentyone years of age and may only be offered one glassof wine or beer, and wine or beer served or consumed shall be purchasedfrom a Washington state licensed retailer. A day spa offering wine orbeer without charge may not advertise the service of complimentary wineor beer and may not sell wine or beer in any manner. (2) For the purposes of this section, "day spa" means a businessthat offers at least three of the following types of beauty services: (a) Hair care, such as shampooing, cutting, styling, or dyeinghair; p. 1 SSB 5045 (b) Nail care, such as manicures and pedicures; (c) Skin care, such as facials or body wraps; (d) Massages; or (e) Body toning equipment. (3) The annual fee for this permit is one hundred twentyfivedollars.
